name: autologger
description: Connect Claude to AutoLogger over MCP and work with your sessions: YouTube/playlist import, transcript cleanup, topics, logged moments, dashboards, show wiki (including detailed, cited whole-show wikis), search and session briefs. Every change is attributed to you and undoable from the session's Agents tab.

server_url.title: AutoLogger URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your AutoLogger server, without a trailing slash (e.g. https://autologger.example.com). Claude signs in through your browser the first time.
